contracts.invariant: Every participant flushes fp/hp, freezes roots, then closes the old-set barrier before the source census or any parity flip. The census counts allocated words, not live words. Two initial destination intervals per participant are necessary, not sufficient.
contracts.open: Per-worker contiguous capacity, captured-frame duplication, chunk markers/terminal fragments and full root ownership remain unproved. No added heap multiplier is credited.
contracts.nativeScope: 51 generated products and full two-pass bootstrap; not a universal packing proof

contracts.cSource: mem.c require_fromspace_copy_source; change_object_scan_state; publish_object_scan; mark_array; mark_captured_continuation; scan
contracts.invariant: A MOVABLE forwarding attempt must refer to the frozen fromspace half. A tospace input is rejected before forwarding; failure coordinates are retained. CAS losers do not increment copied_words. A winning first field is Tail work and later scan skips it.
contracts.quint: copy_custody.forward; copy_custody.initializeCopy; copy_custody.publish; copy_custody.claim; copy_custody.observeDuplicate; copy_custody.completeTail; copy_custody.scan
contracts.open: Destination objects now publish READY after initialization, claim OWNED before field repair and finish DONE. Repeated tasks acquire no second field-write authority; original owner and Tail debts must drain before termination. This is not yet a proof that chunk/root cells are uniquely scanned; C CAS/read memory order and forwarding-before-payload publication need refinement. Runtime guard costs logarithmic lookup per forwarding attempt.
contracts.nativeScope: p11 compiler and host-managed runtime, 80 roots, eleven GCs and multi-shot results, natural shutdown

contracts.invariant: An immutable ABORT permit is independent of join. All contexts initialized, no unknown create, no RUN permit, no allocated movable/still/RC payload, and no activation marker allow heap claims to detach. Native record, gate and descriptors remain retained and cannot be reused. The retained request thunk is scanned by worker zero.
contracts.open: Published retiree, unknown create, raw native borrow, owner interruption or failed isolation remains retained and GC-inadmissible. This is not arbitrary owner-death recovery or a native handle reaper. Current allocation rollback control reaches startup wait failure; four of five controls pass. Its original failure is retained and cannot be erased by scoped unknown-join success.
contracts.nativeScope: three healthy members finish three collections while an unpublished native actor stays held and join is unknown; safety exit only

contracts.cSource: mem.c lock_chunk_fifo; unlock_chunk_fifo; take_heap_chunk; require_chunk_transition; end_heap_chunk; scan_complete_heap_chunk; scan_movable_objs_to_scan; mark_reachable_from_marked
contracts.invariant: Local frontier holds a chunk identity before root copying. Private close publishes queued once; own and stolen dequeue acquire the same FIFO gate and claim queued-to-held before head advance; reaching the terminal marker drains held authority. No unlocked head/tail reads. Chunk completion does not pay object, Tail or frame-link debt.
contracts.open: Packed link/object positions must be disjoint and C adapters must implement acquire/release. A prior p11 own-FIFO claim reached DRAINED state under the generic ticket-lock protocol. The CAS gate retires that transport dependency, not all runtime locks. No fairness, interrupted worker takeover, complete frame-link partition or general physical capacity proof is claimed.
contracts.nativeScope: p11 compiler and host-managed runtime with explicit FIFO gate and frontier, 80 roots and eleven GCs; not C simulation

contracts.cSource: mem.c acquire_frame_access; release_frame_access; mark_captured_continuation_locked; mark_captured_continuation; mark_continuation; mark_frame; scan; ___frame_ordinary_root_begin
contracts.invariant: Initial captured-link read, stack-root repair, stack-to-heap construction and destination frame-link access share one acquire/release domain. Ordinary root runs exclude the structural link without writing FAL; heap-frame link repair is explicit. READY covers raw payload, while frame access gates semantic link completion. Queue gates are released before frame access.
contracts.quint: copy_custody.acquireConstructor; copy_custody.beginFrameChain; copy_custody.publishFrameRaw; copy_custody.repairFrameLink; copy_custody.releaseFrameAccess; copy_custody.acquireScanner; copy_custody.scanOrdinaryFrame
contracts.open: VM-wide serialization may reduce root-scan parallelism. Actual C pointer/root-map refinement, active-stack versus captured-segment separation, module metadata lifetime and unmanaged FFI writers remain premises. New-stack restoration is private until final resumption barrier; arbitrary failed-worker takeover is not admitted.
contracts.nativeScope: p11 compiler/host runtime, multi-shot continuation and wide roots; frame-domain serialization and ordinary/link partition; not arbitrary FFI writer admission

contracts.cSource: mem.c reserve_copy; cancel_copy; commit_copy; finish_tail; mark_array; mark_captured_continuation_locked; garbage_collect_mark_weak_phase
contracts.invariant: An actual private contiguous interval precedes header write and source CAS. Known loss cancels the entire unpublished interval, including alignment slack; known win initializes/publishes then commits. Tail is recorded before publication and paid only when its cell is repaired. Reserved minus cancelled equals copied plus committed padding at the completed marking cut. Unknown outcome cannot authorize refund.
contracts.quint: copy_custody.reservePrivateCopy; copy_custody.loseForwarding; copy_custody.winForwarding; copy_custody.initializeReserved; copy_custody.commitReservation; copy_custody.unknownReservation
contracts.open: Per-copy interval admission is not a complete pre-flip capacity transaction. Current private-context allocation, source census U, frame Amax and marker/terminal packing need a full-round proof. Generator validates stored fs below 16384 and expands internal frames; the 8192 runtime declaration is not that proof. Counter overflow, native cancellation observability and all allocator adapters need qualification.
contracts.nativeScope: whole p11 map/root workload; contiguous per-copy grants and normal CAS-result handling; unknown owner recovery and full-round packing excluded

edges.obligation: Source upper bound may become capacity evidence only after unique scanning and destination packing are proved.
Old collective publishes abort_isolated before healthy GC; detached empty intervals may be reused, stable native identity must not be overwritten.
Disjoint chunk traversal requests do not replace the per-object write claim; copy-winner Tail and special frame links retain separate custody.
A scanner claiming a raw-ready frame must acquire the frame domain before reading the structural link or ordinary roots; constructor writes precede release.
Private grants and known-result refunds provide physical accounting premises; they do not alone establish U, Amax or a pre-flip whole-round grant.
Captured-frame payload construction uses the same contiguous reservation and commit endpoints; frame/link publication does not erase allocation debt.

capacityRule: Conditional: G=L-Amax-4-ceil(L/K)>0; heap sections <= W+floor(U/G); P >= N+2W+floor(U/G)+R+Q includes restoration and retained domains. U, Amax, source identity, packing and Tail/worker closure must be proved before issuing a pre-flip grant. No automatic heap growth from this formula is implemented.
